B9.reason: No ARM64 device is attached to this host (platform=win32-x64). An x86 host cannot produce an ARM jitter figure: the whole point of arm-probe.mjs:2-6 is that CPU throttling on x86 proves a PERFORMANCE gate and can never prove an ARCHITECTURE gate. The owner's relayed ARM jitter (p50 0.84 / p95 4.47 / max 7.71 ms) is retained verbatim under ownerRelayed and is NOT restated as measured by this repository.

B12.reason: Two separable claims sit in this row and they do not stand or fall together. (1) CHECKSUM IDENTITY — corroborated: this independent x86 host computed bench_checksum=2095.419, which matches the owner-relayed value 2095.419 exactly, so the bench is deterministic across machines as claimed. (2) THE 7.18x RATIO — not reproduced: the owner relayed x86 bench_ms 419.48, and this host measures 644.9691 ms, which is outside a 10% band. Had the relayed ARM figure of 3012.39 ms held, the ratio against THIS host would be about 4.67x, not 7.18x. A CPU-only ratio that varies by host cannot be carried onto a render-bound transition budget.
